meta.purpose: Trilingual overlay for build_oct_teaching_deck.py's TEXT dict. 'en' entries are a snapshot for review only — the live English source of truth is TEXT['en'] in build_oct_teaching_deck.py, never this file. 'vi'/'zh' entries are populated ONLY from translations that already exist verbatim elsewhere in the repo (cited per-entry); every sentence without an existing translation is the literal marker UNTRANSLATED, per ASM-007 in the plan. See research/dppa-terminology-map.md for the human-readable term-level vocabulary table and citations.
meta.untranslatedPolicy: build_oct_teaching_deck.py must refuse to build --lang vi or --lang zh while any consumed key's value is UNTRANSLATED for that language.
meta.excludedKeysNote: m6_levers is sourced from assets/teaching/spine-s1.json's 'levers' array (English-only, generated by app/scripts/export-spine.mjs), not from TEXT — out of scope for this map. Translate spine-s1.json's levers separately if/when PHASE-06 needs it.
meta.slotsContract: An entry may carry a sibling "slots" object mapping {placeholder} tokens used in its en/vi/zh text to a JSON-pointer-style path (or, for a derived sum, a list of paths to add) into assets/teaching/spine-s1.json. build_oct_teaching_deck.py substitutes every slot from the spine at build time, formatted per target language, so a translator never types a figure and no slide figure can silently diverge from the settlement engine (see PHASE-03 of plans/2026-08-22-delivery-stall-recovery-plan.md).

cold_open_title.en: Song Hong Garment Co.: one month, two bills
cold_open_title.note: Factory-name-specific; related but non-verbatim asset exists: build_teaching_visuals.py TEXTS.{vi,zh}.cold_open_title ('Cùng một nhà máy, một tháng' / '同一家工厂,同一个月') is a different sentence, not a match.

cold_open_body.en: Today: {bau} tr VND. With a DPPA: {ckh} tr VND. Where did the gap come from? You will compute it.

divider.0.source: build_teaching_visuals.py TEXTS.{vi,zh}.breadcrumb_labels[0] — same module name, exact semantic match.

checkpoint.0.en: If load rises in the evening peak, does your bill rise faster or slower than at noon?

checkpoint.1.en: Which of the five lines disappears when consumption exactly equals matched volume?

checkpoint.2.en: If the market price jumps above the strike mid-afternoon, who pays whom?

checkpoint.3.en: Which of the three doors is hardest to pass when the strike is set too high?

checkpoint.4.en: In the 56-scenario sweep, how many pass all three gates at once?

checkpoint.5.en: Name one lever that would have flipped this month's CfD sign.

m1_title.note: Related non-verbatim asset: build_teaching_visuals.py TEXTS.{vi,zh}.m1_title adds ', hour by hour' — a different sentence.

m1_body.en: Song Hong Garment Co. — hour by hour, before any DPPA. This is the bill every DPPA offer is judged against.

m2a_title.vi: Bao nhiêu điện thực sự được thanh toán?

m2a_body.en: Generation leaks a little, then passes a load gate and a contract gate. Only what survives both gates settles.

m2b_title.en: The five-line bill, one arrow at a time

m2b_body.en: Market energy {marketEnergy} + fees {fees} + CfD {cfd} = {ckh} tr VND.
m2b_body.note: Numbers are supplied by the deck builder from slots (never hand-typed); translate only the surrounding words (“Market energy”/“fees”/“CfD”). See research/dppa-terminology-map.md for the reusable term-level equivalents (Điện năng thị trường / 市场电能, etc.).

m3_title.vi: Khóa giá, không phải giảm giá

m3_body.en: The strike is a seesaw. Below it, you top up the developer. Above it, the developer pays you.

m3_app.en: App moment: drag the market-price slider through the strike and watch the CfD line flip sign.

m4_title.en: Three doors the deal must pass
m4_title.vi: Ba cánh cửa giao dịch phải vượt qua
m4_title.zh: 交易必须通过的三道门

m4_body.en: Buyer: cost below doing nothing. Lender: covered every year. Investor: return earned. All three, or no deal.

m5_title.en: 56 scenarios, how many clear the window
m5_title.note: Related non-verbatim asset: build_teaching_visuals.py TEXTS.{vi,zh}.m5_title ('56 kịch bản: bao nhiêu vượt cả ba cửa?' / '56种情景:有多少能通过全部三道门?') is worded differently (different question), not a match. Reuse its vocabulary when translating.

m5_body.en: Sweep strike x volume across both case studies: 5 of 56 combinations clear all three doors at once.
m5_body.note: The figure '5 of 56' is computed (assets/teaching/gate-sweep.json passCount) and will need re-verification after translation, not just word substitution.

m5_exercise.en: Your turn: compute this factory's five-line bill from the worksheet, then verify it in the app.

m6_decoder_title.en: Decoder: your words, the decree's symbols

m6_decoder_rows.0.plain.source: facilitator/dppa-workshop-facilitator-guide.md cites 'Sản lượng khớp' as the approved VI term for matched/settled volume (also consistent with lessons/0011-worksheets-vi.html's Q_KH/Q_c row labels).

m6_decoder_rows.1.plain.source: facilitator/dppa-workshop-facilitator-guide.md cites 'Phụ tải' (load/consumption) as the approved VI term.

m6_decoder_rows.2.plain.note: FMP itself is a language-invariant symbol (kept as 'FMP' in vi/zh worksheets, e.g. lessons/0011-worksheets-vi.html 'FMP = 1,150') — only the plain-language label 'Market price' needs translation, not yet sourced.

m6_decoder_rows.3.plain.source: facilitator/dppa-workshop-facilitator-guide.md cites 'Giá thực hiện' (VI); lessons/0011-worksheets-zh-cn.html uses '执行价' (strike price) throughout (e.g. '执行价 = 1,250').

m6_decoder_rows.4.plain.note: C_KH itself is language-invariant (kept as 'C_KH' in vi/zh worksheets), but no existing asset translates the plain-language phrase 'Total bill' itself.

m6_levers_title.en: Five levers you can still negotiate

close_title.en: You can now compute every line of this bill

close_body.en: Bring the five levers to your next term sheet. Scan for the app, lessons, and the 90-min scenario workshop.

appendix_titles.0.note: Related non-verbatim asset: lessons/0011-worksheets-{vi,zh-cn}.html 'Phiếu S1 — Khớp (Phụ tải = Phát điện)' / '练习表 S1 — 匹配（负荷 = 发电）' is a worksheet header, not a slide title, but confirms 'Khớp'/'匹配' as the approved word for 'Matched'.

appendix_titles.1.note: Related: lessons/0011-worksheets-zh-cn.html '练习表 S2 — 缺口（负荷 > 发电）' confirms '缺口' as the approved word for 'Shortfall'.

appendix_titles.2.note: Related: lessons/0011-worksheets-zh-cn.html '练习表 S3 — 过剩（负荷 < 发电）' confirms '过剩' as the approved word for 'Excess'; lessons/0011-worksheets-vi.html uses 'Sản lượng dư thừa' (excess volume).

appendix_takeaways.0.en: Consumption equals matched volume. No residual retail line.

appendix_takeaways.1.en: Consumption exceeds contract. The residual buys back at retail — always the expensive line.

appendix_takeaways.2.en: Generation exceeds consumption. The excess earns spot revenue only — no CfD, no free upside.
